lead: Toys, games and hobby models a person owns for play or collecting, organised by kind of play (building, dolls, figures, models and railways, games, pretend, baby, skill, vehicles, outdoor), with hobbyist kinds broken into archetypes and versions and game titles left to the Interactive Entertainment taxonomy.

b.v: EN 71, ASTM F963, ISO 8124, CE, CPSIA met (a gate, not a tier)
b.w: Every toy passes safety first: small parts, chemicals, sharp edges, flammability, labels.

depts.note: LEGO follows Brickset axes: theme → subtheme → set number → year; minifigures separately.

b.w: Brick builders judge systems by how parts grip and fit (LEGO as reference).

b.v: new sealed > complete with box and instructions > complete > incomplete

s.brief: Rebuild LEGO on Brickset axes: themes as archetypes ordered by significance (System/Town/City, Castle, Space, Technic, Duplo, Star Wars, Creator Expert/Icons, Ideas, Architecture, Bionicle, Ninjago, Friends, Harry Potter…), with subthemes, landmark set numbers and years as versions; cut the 140-theme flat range list to significant themes (long tail as stubs). Add Duplo as a type/archetype, LEGO minifigures (Collectable Minifigures series, licensed figures) and other brick systems (Mega Bloks/Mega, COBI, BlueBrixx; Playmobil belongs in Playsets). Add magnetic tiles (Magna-Tiles, Geomag), K'Nex, Meccano/Erector history, KEVA/Kapla, Anchor Stone blocks, wooden unit blocks. Brand register: LEGO, Mega, COBI, Meccano, K'Nex, Kapla.

b.w: Games are judged as objects: components first (Spiel des Jahres jury criteria).

b.w: Collectors and resellers check completeness first.

s.brief: Archetypes by pattern and tradition: chess (Staunton 1849 by Jaques of London, Isle of Lewis, Régence, Dubrovnik, Soviet), go (kaya goban, slate-and-shell stones), shogi (Tendo koma), xiangqi, mahjong (Hong Kong, Japanese, American sets), backgammon (tables), dominoes (double-six, double-nine), mancala/bao, Othello. Add tradition-register entries for go, shogi, xiangqi, mahjong, backgammon, chess-set making. Merge the duplicate chess clock and game clock (DGT, Garde, BHB).

k.brief: Merge of game clock and chess clock.

s.brief: Object only: drop title model lists (titles OUT). Organise by object attributes: publisher (Hasbro, Kosmos, Ravensburger, Asmodee, Z-Man), edition type (first edition, deluxe, collector's, Kickstarter/all-in, expansion), completeness. Playing cards by regional pattern (French, German, Italian, Spanish suits; tarot/tarock) with makers (Piatnik, Bicycle/USPCC, Fournier, Modiano, Cartamundi) and archetypes (Bicycle Rider Back, Anglo-American pattern). Hanafuda (Nintendo). Dice set is for polyhedral and casino dice sets.

k.brief: Polyhedral RPG dice, casino and poker dice.

s.brief: Game view only (collecting/grading in F3, cross-link): game systems as archetypes — Magic: The Gathering (1993), Pokémon TCG, Yu-Gi-Oh!, One Piece, Lorcana, Flesh and Blood; product types (booster, booster box, starter/structure deck, tin). Miniatures games: Warhammer 40,000, Age of Sigmar, Bolt Action, X-Wing, Marvel Crisis Protocol. Accessories: Dragon Shield, KMC, Ultimate Guard, Gamegenic; add playmat and binder.

Jigsaws by maker (Ravensburger, Wasgij, Wentworth wooden, Pomegranate, Liberty) with piece-count types; mechanical puzzles by archetype: Rubik's Cube (1974) and speedcubes (GAN, MoYu), Hanayama Cast, Japanese puzzle box (himitsu-bako, Hakone), burr puzzles, Tower of Hanoi, tangram; 3D puzzles (Puzzleball, Wrebbit).

Archetypes: table football (Bonzini, Garlando, Leonhart, Tornado), air hockey, carrom (Indian tradition; Surco, Precise), crokinole (Canadian; Tracey, Hilinski), pitchnut/novuss, shuffleboard table, bar billiards; dexterity games (Jenga, pick-up sticks, Kerplunk). Billiards/pool tables stay in Sports.
Restraint: merge poker chip case into poker chip set, casino table layout into casino gaming table, raffle drum into bingo set; keep kind level with a few market brands (Dal Negro, Masters, Philos).
